summary.en: Markelic LLC is hiring a Support Engineer for a full-time remote role open to applicants anywhere in the world, offering a monthly salary of $2,300–$3,000. The position requires 2–3 years of experience and a completed bachelor's degree.
summary.lv: Markelic LLC meklē atbalsta inženieri pilna laika attālinātam darbam, kas pieejams pretendentiem no jebkuras pasaules vietas ar mēnešalgu $2 300–$3 000. Amatam nepieciešama 2–3 gadu pieredze un augstākā izglītība.
